newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING says 1996 provisions Dfl 530 mln.
newsitem.headline: ING says 1996 provisions Dfl 530 mln.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday it had allocated 530 million guilders before tax in 1996 to provisions for future expenses.
It said 280 million guilders related to its insurance operations and 250 million to the banking business.

In the first nine months of 1996, the group made provisions totalling 275 million guilders for information technology, reorganisations, enhanced market efforts, the introduction of the euro and the year 2000.

ING said it made additional expense provisions within the insurance division in 1996 totalling 280 million for information technology, reorganisations, the introduction of the euro and the millennium.
The group said expense provisions in 1996 within the banking operations amounted to 250 million guilders and related to information technology, the euro and the millennium.
